title: Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg — original BImSchG approval G07819
procedure: BImSchG approval with environmental impact assessment and concentrated decisions
lead_authority: Landesamt für Umwelt Brandenburg (LfU), Genehmigungsverfahrensstelle Ost
claim_boundary: Observed dates and facts below are grounded in published authority records. This dataset does not infer avoidable authority waiting time where ready-for-review, review-start and decision timestamps are unavailable.

events.fact: Scoping template submitted to LfU.
Scoping meeting held in Frankfurt (Oder).
Expected UVP documentation scope communicated to applicant.
BImSchG application received by LfU (letter dated 2019-12-19).
First public notice published.
First public display of application documents.
373 valid objections recorded by end of first objection period.
First early-start authorization allowed clearing and site-preparation measures at applicant risk.
Originally planned hearing was postponed because of COVID-19 conditions.
Fundamentally revised application submitted; affected bodies had to be consulted again.
Second public notice published after modified application.
Second public display.
414 valid objections in total after second objection period; 41 new objectors in round two.
Public hearing began in Erkner; 210 motions to the permitting authority were made during the hearing.
LfU required an external expert opinion on major-accident-law requirements and site classification.
Application changed again and battery-cell production was added; affected bodies were re-consulted.
Third public notice published.
Third public display.
813 valid objections in total after third objection period; 399 first-time objectors in round three.
Planned hearing cancelled because of high participant numbers and COVID-19 conditions.
First online consultation used as replacement for cancelled hearing.
Second online consultation.
Final approval issued and handed to applicant.
Production launch / first customer vehicle handover reported by Brandenburg government.

observed_drivers.evidence: The final decision records major application changes in June 2020 and June 2021 that triggered renewed authority participation and public process steps.
Three public-display rounds plus hearing/online consultation are recorded.
The March 2020 hearing was postponed and the September 2021 hearing was replaced by online consultation under pandemic conditions.
The final decision lists many specialist authorities and LfU units consulted repeatedly.
Brandenburg reports 19 early-start authorizations and construction beginning before final approval at investor risk.

which reviews were legally dependent versus merely sequenced operationally
applicant response timestamps for each information request
